description.value: The Daajing Giids Visitor Centre is the essential first stop for anyone exploring Haida Gwaii, offering local knowledge on trails, camping, culture, and logistics that no website or app can replicate. Staffed by people who live and travel these roads daily, it serves as the gateway to Gwaii Haanas National Park Reserve, the ancient Haida villages, and dozens of hiking trails across Graham Island. A touring cyclist arriving here will find curated regional intelligence, a gift shop stocked with locally made souvenirs, and a waterfront deck overlooking the bay.

address.value: 3220 Wharf Way, Daajing Giids, BC V0T 1S0
